HCX-005.description: Own Chat Completions v3 documentation names HCX-005 and states a combined input/output limit of 128,000 tokens and a maximum of 4,096 output tokens. The OpenAI-compatible guide uses the same model ID. This initial entry declares text and tool paths, not endpoint-specific image or native strict-schema acceptance. Account availability is unverified.

instructions: Use an eligible NAVER Cloud account and subscribe to CLOVA Studio in the Korea region on Classic or VPC, following https://guide.ncloud-docs.com/docs/en/clovastudio-start.

The official new-signup program at https://www.ncloud.com/main/creditEvent, retrieved 2026-10-09, offers 100,000 KRW discount credit after payment-method registration and a credit application. Eligibility follows the policy at application time; prior recipients of other discounts cannot apply.

Issued credit is usable for three months against NAVER Cloud service charges. Free/trial products, Marketplace purchases and NAVER WORKS are excluded. This is a conditional promotional program, not a no-card free tier or proof of your current entitlement or balance.

Create a CLOVA Studio test or service API key under the CLOVA Studio API-key menu. Its OpenAI-compatible API accepts those keys with Authorization: Bearer; a general NAVER Cloud access key is not a substitute. Set {apiKeyEnvVar}.

The chat base is https://clovastudio.stream.ntruss.com/v1/openai and default model is HCX-005. Auto, none and named tool choices retain their documented meanings. Required tool choice is unsupported and explicitly rejected, never silently downgraded to auto.
setup.description: Documentation-based source pilot. CLOVA Studio is usage-priced; conditional NAVER Cloud promotional credit requires payment-method registration/application and eligibility. Actual account subscription, models, credit balance and live API execution remain unverified. JSON-schema name/strict controls are ignored by the shim, so native strict-schema and tools-plus-schema support are not declared.

rosterVerified.method: Public first-party HCX-005 Chat v3 limits, OpenAI compatibility and function-calling documents only. No authenticated model roster, account/key lookup or inference performed. Limits 128,000 / 4,096 are explicit per-model source constraints, not K/M expansion.

billingProbe.method: Public https://guide.ncloud-docs.com/docs/en/clovastudio-spec confirms usage fees; https://www.ncloud.com/main/creditEvent publishes conditional 100,000 KRW credit, valid three months, after payment-method registration and application. No card-only requirement or current account entitlement is claimed.
